title: loom-worker telemetry collection and advertisement extension
intent: loom-worker publishes static inventory and live host telemetry in Kind 10100 worker advertisements without breaking old Bahia readers.
scope: loom-worker TypeScript only: telemetry collectors, telemetry sampler service, Kind 10100 advertisement payload extension, queue lifecycle republish wiring, and configuration knobs.
observed_behavior_before: Worker advertisements contained name, description, max_concurrent_jobs, and current_queue_depth only; advertisement cadence was hardcoded; queue depth changes waited for the periodic advertisement; Kind 10100 created_at was not mined for same-second replacement ordering.
intended_behavior: Worker advertisements include resources, accelerators, and best-effort telemetry content. Collector failures omit only the failed section. Queue depth changes trigger immediate republish, post-job ads use a refreshed snapshot, and Kind 10100 created_at remains monotonic for same-second updates.
